title: 2026 Seoul Marathon — venue layout guide (Gwanghwamun start, Jamsil finish)
publisher: Seoul Marathon Organizing Committee (The Dong-A Ilbo)
claims: Full Course Start | Gwanghwamun; 10K Start | Jamsil; Full Course and 10K Finish | Jamsil.

The Gwanghwamun start layout has an elite start line, a warm-up zone, A–G group corrals, bag-deposit trucks by group, a dressing room and toilets; the Jamsil finish zone has medal, poncho and snack distribution, medical, changing rooms, South Gate and Sports Complex Station.
Participants are strongly encouraged to use public transport to avoid congestion.
